headlines.title: Fed holds interest rates for a seventh-consecutive month, underscoring inflation concerns
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve left its key interest rate unchanged for the seventh month despite concerns about inflation that continues to pressure U.S. households.

headlines.title: Dr. Fauci invokes his Fifth Amendment right not to testify at Senate hearing
headlines.description: During his opening statement, Dr. Anthony Fauci said he would invoke his Fifth Amendment right and will refrain from answering questions from Senators in their probe of his Covid pandemic response.

headlines.title: President Trump makes announcement alongside the secretary of transportation
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as President Trump makes an announcement alongside Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy.

headlines.title: Iran Launches Surprise Missile Attack on US Forces in Middle East
headlines.description: After a dayslong pause in direct strikes between the United States and Iran, the war is flaring up again after U.S. Central Command said it intercepted multiple ballistic missiles launched in a surprise attack by Iran on US forces late Tuesday. It comes just hours after President Donald Trump touted progress in peace talks and as the conflict enters its sixth month. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: France Orders 4,000 More to Evacuate Amid New Heat Wave
headlines.description: Authorities in France have ordered 4,000 more people to evacuate from its tourist sites along its Atlantic coast, as returning heat threatens to erase the gains of firefighters. NBC’s Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY from France.

headlines.title: Mia Bieniemy, wife of Kansas City Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy allegedly shot by their son, out of ICU
headlines.description: The wife of Kansas City Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy, who was wounded Sunday night in a shooting inside the couple’s Northern Virginia home, was moved out of intensive care, Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Wednesday.

headlines.title: Trump to announce plans for Dulles Airport makeover
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is set to announce a sweeping makeover of Dulles International Airport, including the construction of new terminals and the removal of the airport’s aging shuttles.

headlines.title: K-pop group BTS won’t submit its music for Grammy Awards
headlines.description: K-pop band BTS said that it will not submit its music for consideration at the 2027 Grammy Awards, citing concerns over category divisions.

headlines.title: Anthony Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment right not to testify at Covid hearing
headlines.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci declined to answer senators’ questions at a contentious hearing Wednesday on the origins of Covid and the government’s handling of the pandemic, saying he would invoke his Fifth Amendment right to avoid the possibility that Republicans use his testimony to prosecute him for perjury.

headlines.title: Skechers are up to 49% off just in time for your trips to Paris, Rome and other cities with cobblestone streets
headlines.description: Skechers walking shoes are up to 49 percent off right now — they’re perfect for summer travel to cities with cobblestone streets and for all-day comfort at theme parks.

headlines.title: One editor, 16 products, 3 months — my full brand review of Beyonce’s Cécred hair care
headlines.description: I put Cécred’s viral hair care to the test and tried 16 products, including shampoos, conditioners, treatments and more, to see what really lives up to the hype.

headlines.title: The best editor-approved meat delivery services in 2026
headlines.description: We tested steak, chicken, seafood and more from brands like Omaha Steaks, Butcherbox, and Lobsterboys to see which has the best meat delivery service for your next BBQ.
